articles.summary: 文章公布了WN Conference Cyprus '26的议程，会议将于9月17-18日在利马索尔举办，重点聚焦人脉交流和圆桌讨论。核心议题包括2026年游戏投资、Playrix分享生产流程提效、UA新渠道与AI投放、Steam营销挑战以及行业未来走向，参与者包括Deconstructor of Fun、Nival、GEM Capital等。对从业者的价值在于提前了解会议重点话题与可关注的嘉宾，便于安排参会和商务沟通。

WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 的议程已经公布。参与方包括 Owlcat Games、Nexters、Playrix、Deconstructor of Fun 等众多公司
发布者
admin
标签：
WN Cyprus 26
、
wnconf
距离WN Conference在塞浦路斯举办还有不到一个月的时间。会议将于9月17日至18日在利马索尔举行。我们将在文章中讨论对活动议程的期待。
WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 将主要聚焦于社交环节。与会者将有机会参与各种圆桌讨论和小组工作环节。不过，他们也可以聆听传统的讲座。
所有计划中的讨论无法在一篇文章中全部列出，因此我们将重点介绍最有趣的部分。
其中一场重要的圆桌讨论将由 Michail Katkoff 主持，他是分析博客 Deconstructor of Fun 的创始人，同时也是 Zynga、Rovio Entertainment 和 Supercell 等公司的资深从业者。具体主题将在稍后公布。
会议还将举办一场主题为“数据与信念之跃：2026年游戏投资”的圆桌讨论。主持人将是 GEM Capital 的董事总经理 Kirill Gurskiy。
Playrix 的项目经理 Murad Musakaev 将就生产过程中的隐性时间损耗进行演讲。他将讲解如何识别不必要的任务、自动化操作，并最终节省大量时间。
Colossi Games 的联合创始人兼首席执行官 Manuel Prueter 将主持一场关于用户获取的圆桌讨论。主题为：“新的用户获取技术栈：分销渠道、AI 与更明智的支出”。
Tapclap 的人力资源业务伙伴 Ekaterina Mitina 将主持一场关于当前人力资源管理现状的圆桌讨论。
另一场圆桌讨论将聚焦 Steam 的营销挑战。参与者将讨论 2026 年的理想游戏应该是什么样，应该使用哪些工具和策略来推广项目，以及如何在发布期间行动。
在“欢迎来到末日：游戏的未来”圆桌讨论中，游戏行业资深人士将讨论当前游戏行业正在发生的事情。重组、AI 发展和用户行为变化应被视为危机，还是新周期的开始？参与者包括 Nival 的创始人 Sergey Orlovsky、Utmost Games 的创始人 Vladimir Nikolsky 以及 Vizor Interactive 的联合创始人 Sergey Bruy。
此外，在由 GEM Capital 支持的 WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 上，将有一个大型开发者展览，并伴有独立游戏路演——向投资者和行业专家展示游戏。请注意，这两项活动的申请截止日期均为9月11日，但独立游戏路演的筛选是单独进行的。
会议还将包括由 OHM 支持的抽奖活动（参与者之间的奖品抽取）。
别忘了还有设有赞助商展位的展览区。除了 GEM Capital 和 OHM，Loot、Xsolla、Avow、OHM、Salary.cab、AppFollow、Malpa Games、Garna、Jungle Technology 和 AppGrowing 等公司也将出席。
会议的一个亮点将是其自己的颁奖典礼，名为“塞浦路斯游戏行业大奖”，旨在表彰过去一年塞浦路斯游戏开发领域的成就。主要运营在塞浦路斯进行的公司，即使总部设在其他地方，也可以获得提名。
共有六个奖项类别：
年度移动游戏成就奖；
年度 PC 与主机成就奖；
年度发行商奖；
人与工作场所奖；
年度增长与创意合作伙伴奖；
年度游戏商务与支付合作伙伴奖。
目前，任何人都可以在奖项网站上为塞浦路斯游戏行业大奖提名候选人。WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 的组织方将在会议开始前不久公布入围名单，获奖者将在活动第一天结束时公布。
9月17日晚，还将为 WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 的高级门票持有者举办一场社交派对。地点目前保密。WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 的颁奖典礼将在派对期间举行，这对获奖者来说将是一个特别愉快的时刻。
提醒：WN Conference 塞浦路斯 '26 的门票目前正在打折。开发者与发行商票价起价为399欧元，服务提供商起价为1199欧元。如果你想参加，请抓紧时间。价格之后会上涨。还可以使用 WN Wishlist 功能将会议门票加入愿望清单，这可以将折扣延长一周。
***

The program for the WN Conference Cyprus ’26 has been released. Among the participants are Owlcat Games, Nexters, Playrix, Deconstructor of Fun, and many others
Published by
admin
Tags:
WN Cyprus 26
,
wnconf
There is just over a month left until the
WN Conference
session in Cyprus takes place. It will be held on September 17-18 in Limassol. We discuss what to expect from the event program in our article.
The WN Conference Cyprus’26 will primarily focus on networking. Attendees will have the opportunity to participate in various round tables and group work sessions. However, they will also have the chance to listen to traditional lectures.
It’s impossible to list all the planned discussions in a single publication, so we’ll highlight the most interesting ones.
One of the key panel discussions will be conducted by Michail Katkoff, the founder of the analytical blog Deconstructor of Fun and a veteran of companies such as Zynga, Rovio Entertainment, and Supercell. The exact topic will be announced later.
The conference will also feature a panel discussion on the topic “Data and the Leap of Faith: Investing in Games in 2026.” It will be moderated by Kirill Gurskiy, Managing Director of GEM Capital.
Project Manager at Playrix, Murad Musakaev, will present on hidden time losses in the production process. He will explain how to identify unnecessary tasks, automate operations, and ultimately save a significant amount of time.
Co-founder and CEO of Colossi Games, Manuel Prueter, will moderate a round table dedicated to user acquisition. The topic is titled: “The New UA Stack: Distribution Channels, AI, and Smarter Spend.”
HR Business Partner at Tapclap, Ekaterina Mitina, will hold a panel discussion on the current situation in HR management.
Another round table will focus on Steam’s marketing challenges. Its participants will discuss what the ideal game of 2026 should look like, what tools and tactics should be used to promote projects, and how to act during a release.
In the round table “Welcome to the End Times: The Future of Games,” gaming industry veterans will discuss what is currently happening in the gaming industry. Should the restructurings, AI developments, and changes in user behavior be considered a crisis, or are they the start of a new cycle? Participants include the founder of Nival, Sergey Orlovsky, founder of Utmost Games, Vladimir Nikolsky, and co-founder of Vizor Interactive, Sergey Bruy.
Additionally, at the WN Conference Cyprus’26 supported by GEM Capital, there will be a large developer exhibition, accompanied by an indie pitch — a presentation of games before investors and industry experts. Please note that
applications
for both activities are accepted until September 11, but the indie pitch selection is conducted separately.
The conference will also include a raffle (prize draw among participants) supported by OHM.
Don’t forget about the expo zone with sponsor booths. In addition to GEM Capital and OHM, companies like Loot, Xsolla, Avow, OHM, Salary.cab, AppFollow, Malpa Games, Garna, Jungle Technology, and AppGrowing will also be present.
One of the conference’s highlights will be its own award ceremony called the Cyprus Game Industry Awards, recognizing achievements in Cypriot game development over the past year. Companies whose primary operations are conducted in Cyprus, even if they are based elsewhere, can be recognized.
There are six award categories:
Mobile Games Achievement of the Year;
PC & Console Achievement of the Year;
Publisher of the Year;
People & Workplace Award;
Growth & Creative Partner of the Year;
Games Commerce & Payments Partner of the Year.
At present, anyone can propose nominees for the Cyprus Game Industry Awards on the
award’s website
. The organizers of the WN Conference Cyprus’26 will announce a shortlist shortly before the conference starts, and winners will be announced at the end of the first day of the event.
On the evening of September 17, there will also be a networking party for premium ticket holders of the WN Conference Cyprus’26. The location is currently kept secret. The ceremony of the WN Conference Cyprus’26 awards will take place during the party, making it an especially joyous occasion for the winners.
Reminder: tickets for the WN Conference Cyprus’26 are currently available at a discount. Prices
start
at 399 euros for developers and publishers, and from 1199 euros for service providers. If you wish to participate, hurry up. Prices will increase later. There is also an option to add conference tickets to your wishlist using the WN Wishlist feature, which extends the discount for another week.
***
The full program can be viewed on the
WN Conference Cyprus’26
website.
